name: 4F-PHP
summary: 4-Fluoro analogue of a-PHP. There are some reports indicating it has less manic effects than a-PHP, however the dosages seem similar.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet

uses.text: 4-Fluoro-alpha-PHP (4F-PHP) is a recreational designer drug from the substituted cathinone family with stimulant effects, which first appeared on the illicit market in around 2017.

pharmacology.en: Little has been published about it. Like α-PHP and α-PVP, it is thought to block the reuptake of dopamine and noradrenaline.
pharmacology.zh: 相關研究很少。一般認為它和α-PHP及α-PVP一樣，會阻斷多巴胺與正腎上腺素的回收。
pharmacology.zhHans: 相关研究很少。一般认为它和α-PHP及α-PVP一样，会阻断多巴胺与正肾上腺素的回收。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the α-pyrrolidinophenones such as α-PVP, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, insomnia, agitation, paranoia and a strong urge to keep redosing. Serious risks include psychosis, violent agitation, heart problems, seizures and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同家族的α-吡咯烷苯酮類藥物（例如α-PVP），可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、失眠、躁動、多疑，以及想一再追加用藥的強烈衝動。嚴重風險包括精神病、激烈躁動、心臟問題、癲癇發作與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同家族的α-吡咯烷苯酮类药物（例如α-PVP），可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、失眠、躁动、多疑，以及想一再追加用药的强烈冲动。严重风险包括精神病、激烈躁动、心脏问题、癫痫发作与成瘾。

fact.en: It is the fluorinated version of α-PHP, whose name reflects its six-carbon hexanophenone chain. It first appeared on the illicit market around 2017.
fact.zh: 它是α-PHP的氟化版本；α-PHP的名稱反映了它六個碳的己醯苯（hexanophenone）鏈。它大約在2017年首次出現在非法市場。
fact.zhHans: 它是α-PHP的氟化版本；α-PHP的名称反映了它六个碳的己酰苯（hexanophenone）链。它大约在2017年首次出现在非法市场。
